player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.bad_format: Dienza dia malu mabi. Kuata mudimu ne "[b1 c3]".

invalid_move.not_your_piece: Tshisese ki ntshiena bualu buebe to.
invalid_move.own_piece: Katuena mua kuimana pa mutu pende to.
invalid_move.not_knight: Ki mmushindu wa bu muntu mupiluke to.

game_action.moved: Muena manaya {player_id} wakumbusha tshiamu tshiende tshia nkudimuinu ku {frm} kuya mu {to}.

outcome.move_limit: Bungi bua bintu bidibu mua kuenza bukadi bufike.
